objective: Extend the fixture's math module with a median helper, verified by its own tests.

stories.who: A developer using the fixture's math module
stories.problem: There is no median helper, so each caller sorts and indexes a list by hand.
stories.outcome: They call median and get the middle value, tested.

stories.who: Anyone already calling the math module
stories.problem: A change to the module could quietly break a helper they rely on.
stories.outcome: Every existing helper behaves exactly as before.

successCriteria.outcome: median returns the middle value of an odd-length list.

constraints: Keep every existing helper behaving exactly as it does.
Add no dependency: verification runs on a clean checkout with no install.

verification.description: The fixture's own tests, on a clean checkout. The reporter is named because the suites read its summary lines (`# pass`, `# fail`), and Node 24 made `spec` the default where Node 22 printed TAP to a pipe.

verification.command: node -e "import('./src/index.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.sum !== 'function') { throw new Error('src/index.js must still export sum'); } })"
verification.description: A second, cheap step, so a Verification carries more than one command.
